# The paths of planning, prose and site files, read by taskfiles/classify-changes.sh. On the
# forge (.github/workflows/check.yml) a change whose files are all planning or prose files runs
# python-check only; one whose files are all planning, prose or site files, at least one of the
# site, runs python-check and site-data-check; any other change runs task check.
#
# One line per pattern: "<class> <pattern>". A line that starts with # is a comment; a blank
# line is skipped. The class is one of
#   prose  a planning or prose file;
#   site   a file of the documentation site, checked by site-data-check and built by the
#          site's own workflows, not by the code's build and tests; wins over prose;
#   code   a file a gate step, a test or a build of the code reads; wins over site and prose.
# A pattern is a shell pattern over the path from the repository root, in which * also matches
# "/" (".engineering/*" is every file under .engineering/). A path that no line matches is
# code. The forge reads this file from the base of the change, and a change of this file is
# code.
#
# A Markdown file a gate step reads as data gets a code line here, with the task that reads it;
# so does a file under website/ that a gate step reads as data of the code (none today).

prose .engineering/*
prose *.md

# test262-check, test262-moves-check, test262-sources (taskfiles/test262.yml) and site-data
# (taskfiles/site.yml): the swell-slices block and the count table.
code docs/design/engine.md
# host-requirements-check (taskfiles/host-requirements.yml): the HOST-<n> requirements.
code docs/design/host-interface.md
# host-surface-check (taskfiles/host-surface.yml): the names under "### Host interface" of [Unreleased].
code CHANGELOG.md
# Files under these directories are read by tests, builds and gate steps (the fixtures
# crates/test262/tests/fixtures/*.md are read by the tests of swell-test262).
code crates/*
code tests/*
code conformance/*
code spec/*
code data/*

# The documentation site; website/data/status.json is written from the gate's files by
# site-data and held by site-data-check. docs/img/: the logo's lockup for README.md.
site website/*
site docs/img/*

site bench/engines.jsonl
site bench/published/*
